content: framer-motion and motion packages are both at v12.42.2 on npm (verified 2026-07-20) — framer-motion now re-exports the renamed 'motion' package; new code should import from 'motion/react'. Full React 19 concurrent-rendering support. v12 added oklch/oklab/color-mix-aware color interpolation, hardware-accelerated scroll animations, and CSS ViewTimeline support.
